column2: and a sanity check on the table's symmetry. (C1) All eight corner influences are computed and are equal within each octahedral symmetry class
column3: which they must be if the table is octahedrally correct -- making this a cheap independent check on validate_table(). (C2) Total influence is reported and compared against the average sensitivity a refinement heuristic would need. SHARE: none.
